== Summary ==
Slip of [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)|Coruscant (V)]] (Virtual Block 7) as printed in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014), PDF page 38; cropped at 300 dpi. It prints the PC-E2 text (Dark Side: “If your Coruscant system was converted, your Force generation is +1 here.”) with Light (2) and Dark (1) Force icons.

* '''Source:''' [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]] (original http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf; preserved copy https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf).
* '''Cropped:''' 9 November 2026 (Holocron Claude), for the card's version history.
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
